en:
Night Shift - episode three
http://example.test/subs

- Are you awake?
- Barely.

- Did the harbour master call?
- Not yet, he did not.
ar: - هل اتصل رئيس الميناء؟ - ليس بعد.

en:
- Where is Omar tonight?
- Down at the gate.
ar:
أين عمر الليلة؟
هو عند البوابة.

en: The lights went out at midnight.
Nobody answered the radio.

The tide will turn before dawn
and the gate will be locked.
ar: سيتغير المد قبل الفجر وتغلق البوابة عند ذلك الوقت.

en: I told them the paperwork was already filed.
ar: أخبرتهم أن الأوراق قد قدمت بالفعل إلى المكتب الرئيسي.

en: The keys are in the top drawer.
Get away from that crane!
The manifest says the crate is from Beijing.
ar: تقول القائمة إن الصندوق قادم من 北京.

en: He is waiting in the motel lobby.
And Joey locked the door behind him.
The radio is a Marlin 400.

The log book is on the shelf.
Check the last page.
ar:
دفتر السجل على الرف.
تحقق من الصفحة الأخيرة.

en: The coffee machine is broken again.
Then I will make coffee at home.
Our harbour master signed the form.
The night shift starts in ten minutes.
ar: تبدأ نوبة الليل بعد عشر دقائق.

en: Did you check the west gate?
Nadia wants the log before she leaves.
ar: تريد نادية السجل قبل أن تغادر.

en: She read the whole page out loud.
A harbour master never sleeps.
All right, get the lantern.
Okay, but hurry up now.
I am on night shift again.
ar: أنا في نوبة الليل مرة أخرى.

en: Harbour master Reyes wants the log.
The crane has been idle since six.
Nobody logged the last delivery.
I promised the crew we would finish by two.
ar: وعدت الطاقم أن ننتهي بحلول الثانية وقال إن البوابة تغلق منتصف الليل.

en: He said the gate closes at midnight.
Tell the harbour master we are ready.
Every night shift ends the same way.
ar: كل نوبة الليل تنتهي بالطريقة نفسها.

en: Omar left his jacket on the chair.
The harbour master called twice tonight.
Put the crate down before you drop it.
Nadia says the west gate is jammed.
ar: تقول نادية إن البوابة الغربية عالقة.

en: We can finish the paperwork tomorrow.
Omar, the west gate is open.
The last ferry left an hour ago.
Omar closed the gate at last.
Nadia signed the book and left.
The harbour was quiet after that.
Rain started before the shift ended.
Nobody spoke on the way home.
The lamps went out one by one.
A dog barked somewhere behind us.
The keys are back in the drawer.
Tomorrow the crane will run again.
Good night, and thank you.
